notes.title: Neon Runners Playtest on Steam February 28, 2024 - March 1, 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858397/1d32785a363508b6fb19830aa2951a7a0132df2b.gif

After a year of development on Neon Runners, we're thrilled to announce a two-day playtest event available on Steam.


➤ Overview of the Playtest
To kick off the playtest, streamers Bruce Greene, Aplfisher, Timdoggrev, and TsuBunnii will be playing and live streaming Neon Runners on Twitch.

➤ Playtest Schedule
The event will run from February 28, 2024, at 2 PM PST until March 1, 2024, at 2 PM PST, lasting for a total of 48 hours.

➤ Participation Details
To join, click the "Request Access" button on Steam store page. Access will be granted until the end of the playtest period on March 1st, 2024, at 2 PM PST.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858397/1143816855ce9499073c43a0e4e01701bd253c3b.png

➤ Feedback
Please join Discord Server and share your thoughts in the #feedback channel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858397/a1485d6ce8895d65fb64ffb325cd55ced804ef07.png


Thanks,
